And-Input.description: Conjunction of at least two operands.
And-Input.title: And

And-Output.description: Conjunction of at least two operands.
And-Output.title: And

Answer.description: The answer of the user to an open question.
Answer.title: Answer

AnswerRequest.description: Body of ``POST /v1/sessions/{id}/answers``: the open question and the answer.
AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest

ArcView.description: An arc with both ends cited by reference.
ArcView.title: ArcView

AssistantMessage.description: Text written by the LLM. It is labelled as such: never a verdict, never a fact of the net.
AssistantMessage.title: AssistantMessage

AtomKinds.description: Which classes of atom a formula uses; the MCC keeps two classes apart.
AtomKinds.title: AtomKinds

net.description: PNML, or a JSON net document (.json)
net.title: Net

BudgetExhausted.description: The run stopped because it reached a budget.
BudgetExhausted.title: BudgetExhausted

CheckSubmitted.description: A check was queued on the platform for some formulas.
CheckSubmitted.title: CheckSubmitted

Compare.description: Cardinality atom on general terms, such as ``p1 + p2 <= p3``.
Compare.title: Compare

CtlUnary-Input.description: CTL operators with one operand: a path quantifier and a temporal operator.
CtlUnary-Input.title: CtlUnary

CtlUnary-Output.description: CTL operators with one operand: a path quantifier and a temporal operator.
CtlUnary-Output.title: CtlUnary

CtlUntil-Input.description: CTL until under a path quantifier.
CtlUntil-Input.title: CtlUntil

CtlUntil-Output.description: CTL until under a path quantifier.
CtlUntil-Output.title: CtlUntil

Description.description: A description of a net, with the origin of the link to that net.
Description.title: Description

DescriptionAccepted.description: The user accepted a proposed description: it is now stored, with the origin ``llm``.
DescriptionAccepted.title: DescriptionAccepted

DescriptionProposed.description: The LLM proposes a clearer description; it is stored only if the user accepts it.
DescriptionProposed.title: DescriptionProposed

DistantElement.description: An element of a neighbourhood and its distance, in arcs, from the nearest center.
DistantElement.title: DistantElement

ElementDetail.description:
One place or transition with the elements around it.

For a place, ``inputs`` are the transitions that put tokens in it and ``outputs`` those that
take tokens out; for a transition, ``inputs`` are its source places and ``outputs`` its target
places.
ElementDetail.title: ElementDetail

ElementRef.description: Cite a place or a transition by id; the name is kept exactly as in the net.
ElementRef.title: ElementRef

Enabled.description: Fireability atom: the transition can fire.
Enabled.title: Enabled

EngineInfo.description: Capabilities and availability of one engine.
EngineInfo.title: EngineInfo

ErrorInfo.description: Expected failure of a tool (timeout, out of memory, ...), reported in the envelope.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

Formula-Input.description:
A property to check, with the plain-language gloss its proposer gave and its origin.

``logic`` is ``ltl`` (checked on every run), ``ctl`` (branching time) or ``state`` (a
condition on one marking, checked for reachability: some reachable marking satisfies it).
Formula-Input.title: Formula

Formula-Output.description:
A property to check, with the plain-language gloss its proposer gave and its origin.

``logic`` is ``ltl`` (checked on every run), ``ctl`` (branching time) or ``state`` (a
condition on one marking, checked for reachability: some reachable marking satisfies it).
Formula-Output.title: Formula

FormulaReport.description: Outcome of checking a formula against a net.
FormulaReport.title: FormulaReport

FormulaResult.description: Verdict of one formula, with the engine that produced it.
FormulaResult.title: FormulaResult

FormulaValidationRequest.description: Body of ``POST /v1/formulas/validate``: a net and either a formula tree or formula text.
FormulaValidationRequest.title: FormulaValidationRequest

IndexRange.description: The values taken by one number in a family of names.
IndexRange.title: IndexRange

Issue.description: An error or a warning, with a JSON pointer to the part of the formula it is about.
Issue.title: Issue

Job.description: An asynchronous check of a set of formulas on one net.
Job.title: Job

Limits.description: Resource limits applied to one engine run.
Limits.title: Limits

LtlUnary-Input.description: LTL operators with one operand: always, eventually, next.
LtlUnary-Input.title: LtlUnary

LtlUnary-Output.description: LTL operators with one operand: always, eventually, next.
LtlUnary-Output.title: LtlUnary

Marking.description: A sparse marking: places holding no token are omitted; entries are sorted by place id.
Marking.title: Marking

MarkingEntry.description: A place holding at least one token.
MarkingEntry.title: MarkingEntry

MissingTokens.description: A place that holds fewer tokens than a firing needs.
MissingTokens.title: MissingTokens

NameGroup.description:
A family of names that differ only by numbers, such as ``fork_1`` to ``fork_5``.

``pattern`` writes each number as ``{}``; ``indices`` gives one range per ``{}``. It is a
description: the ids to use are those of ``/places`` and ``/transitions``.
NameGroup.title: NameGroup

Neighbourhood.description:
The elements within a distance of some centers, and the arcs between them.

``cut`` is true when the size cap stopped the exploration: more elements exist at a distance
not above ``depth``.
Neighbourhood.title: Neighbourhood

Neighbours.description: Some neighbours of an element: at most ``DETAIL_LINK_LIMIT``, with the real total.
Neighbours.title: Neighbours

NetOverview.description: Counts and structural flags of a net: no names.

has_weighted_arcs.description: Some arc has a weight above 1; undefined for nets that are not P/T
has_weighted_arcs.title: Has Weighted Arcs

NetOverview.title: NetOverview

NetRegistration.description: Answer to ``POST /v1/nets``: the id, whether the net is new, and its summary.
NetRegistration.title: NetRegistration

NetSummary.description: What the API says about a stored net. Names are reached through inspection, not here.
NetSummary.title: NetSummary

Or-Input.description: Disjunction of at least two operands.
Or-Input.title: Or

Or-Output.description: Disjunction of at least two operands.
Or-Output.title: Or

Page.description: Says how much of a list was returned, how much exists, and how to get the rest.
Page.title: Page

PageRequest.description: Pagination parameters of a list request.
PageRequest.title: PageRequest

PropertyProposed.description: A property the LLM proposes to check, with its reason.
PropertyProposed.title: PropertyProposed

Question.description: The LLM asks the user something; the session waits for the answer.
Question.title: Question

ReplayFailure.description: Where a replay stopped: the firing that was not enabled and what was missing.
ReplayFailure.title: ReplayFailure

Session.description: A conversation about one net, with an optional description and the goal of the user.
Session.title: Session

SessionError.description: The run failed for a reason that is not the user's.
SessionError.title: SessionError

SessionStarted.description: The inputs of the user: the net, an optional description and the goal.
SessionStarted.title: SessionStarted

SessionState.description: Where a session is in its life.
SessionState.title: SessionState

StartSessionRequest.description: Body of ``POST /v1/sessions``: the net, an optional description and the goal.
StartSessionRequest.title: StartSessionRequest

StoredEvent.description: An event with its place in the session: numbers start at 1 and only grow by one.
StoredEvent.title: StoredEvent

TokenCount.description: A term: the sum of the tokens held by some places.
TokenCount.title: TokenCount

Tokens.description: Cardinality atom on one place: its tokens compared with a constant.
Tokens.title: Tokens

ToolCall.description: The LLM asked for a tool; ``arguments`` is the JSON text it gave.
ToolCall.title: ToolCall

ToolInfo.description: The tool and pinned version that produced a result.
ToolInfo.title: ToolInfo

ToolResult.description: What a tool answered, as text, exactly as the model saw it (ADR 0017).
ToolResult.title: ToolResult

Trace.description: A counterexample on the original net, validated against it (docs/json-contract.md).
Trace.title: Trace

TraceStep.description: One firing, as the platform reports it: the transition cited by reference.
TraceStep.title: TraceStep

WeightedRef.description: A neighbour of an element, and the arc that links them.
WeightedRef.title: WeightedRef

app__domain__models__Verdict.description: Outcome of one verification. UNKNOWN must never be confused with FALSE.
app__domain__models__Verdict.title: Verdict

app__domain__sessions__Verdict.description:
The verdict an engine gave: the only way a verdict enters a conversation (ADR 0006).

It refers to the job and the result of the engine that produced it, and names the engine and
its version. It cannot be built without them.
app__domain__sessions__Verdict.title: Verdict

delete.description: Unlink a description from a net; its text is deleted when no net uses it.

parameters.description: The net the description is unlinked from
parameters.name: net_id

schema.description: The net the description is unlinked from
schema.title: Net Id

get.description: A description with its links to nets (one entry per net and origin).
List the registered engines and whether they are available here.

post.description: Parse and check a formula on a net: errors, warnings, atom classes, canonical text.

delete.description: Cancel a job that has not finished.

get.description: Return a job with its state and results.
Return the counterexample of one result: the transitions fired, on the original net.

post.description: Register a net: a JSON net document (default) or PNML. The id is the hash of the document.

delete.description: Delete a net. Refused (409) while something uses it, unless ``cascade`` is set.

parameters.description: Also delete its jobs and sessions
parameters.name: cascade

schema.description: Also delete its jobs and sessions
schema.title: Cascade

get.description: Return the net: its JSON document (default) or canonical PNML with ``Accept``.
Arcs sorted by id, filtered by source or target element.

post.description: Queue (or reuse) an asynchronous check of formulas on a net; a worker runs it.

get.description: The descriptions of a net, oldest first.

post.description: Add a description (text/plain or text/markdown) to a net; the same text is a no-op.

get.description: One place or transition: name, tokens, and the arcs into and out of it.
The places holding tokens initially (P/T nets).
Families of indexed names (``fork_1`` to ``fork_5``) as pattern, ranges and count.
Elements within a distance of some elements, capped, with an explicit cut marker.
Places sorted by id, filtered by name pattern or initial marking.

post.description: Fire transitions in order on a P/T net; say where it fails and return the markings met.

get.description: Places and transitions whose name or id matches.
Size, kind, size category and structural flags of the net: counts, no names.
Transitions sorted by id, filtered by name pattern.

post.description: Open a session on a net; the agent starts working at once.

Register the net, store the description, and open the session: one request.

A description typed in the form wins over a description file. Nothing is attached to the
(immutable) net except the description, linked with the origin ``user``.

delete.description: Delete a session and its events (its run is cancelled first).

post.description: Answer the question the agent is waiting on.
Cancel a session: the run stops and a check in progress is cancelled.
Store a description the assistant proposed: only the user's acceptance does it.

get.description:
The events of a session: JSON, or a stream with ``Accept: text/event-stream``.

A stream resumes after ``after`` or after the ``Last-Event-ID`` header; without ``follow`` it
ends when there is nothing more to send.

post.description: Add a message once the agent has finished its turn.

get.description: The report of a session: JSON (default), or Markdown with ``Accept: text/markdown``.

post.description: Open a new session with the goal of this one, with or without its description.
